summary: Landed the jira-clone witness core schema and its generic wiring. Additive only: witnessRecordedRequestPath makes non-loopback records query-free (same-origin unchanged), the cancelled-duplicate category matches through it and carries nonLoopbackScope only when a non-loopback member exists, plus a new mocked-seam inventory, rendered-style and application-journey slots through AppSpec/JourneyLifecycle/executeRun. New core schema pins source identity, four bound mj3c receipts, eight query-free seams, the Sentry-envelope member, board/style/scroll/route evidence, with parser, renderer, verifier, aggregate member, barrel export. 32 new tests. tsc, lint (0 errors) and 151 files / 1183 node tests green; factoriolab, hospitalrun and papercups verifiers untouched and passing.
open_questions: mw1b published no style-probe labels/selectors/values and no tracked-event counts, so the schema enforces probe count (7), cross-lane identity and published-once equality rather than pinning literals. The journey unit must supply the seven probe definitions and will need no schema change to do so.

readiness.angularLineage/overall are shape-checked (counted:false, integer ready<=total) rather than pinned to numbers, because the corpus tallies are a repo-state fact the publish unit knows and this unit does not.
